product: Canadian Gridded Homogenized Monthly Precipitation – Version 2 (CanGridP mlyV2)
format: NetCDF classic CDF1; CF-1.6 declaration; float64 precipitation
geographicCoordinates: Source 2D lat/lon float64 arrays, both dimensions [x,y]; use these arrays for registration.
sourceXYWarning: The x/y variables contain integer grid indices but have degree units. Do not interpret x/y as geographic longitude/latitude.
documentedProjection: Polar stereographic, true at 60 degrees north, centered on 110 degrees west, approximately 10 km resolution. The catalogue calls the grid EASE; do not claim strict equal-area or invent an EPSG code.
landVariable: land; 1 land, 0 nonland; 100945 land cells out of 291870 rectangular cells
landMaskWarning: In the inspected January 1991 record, all 291870 precipitation values are numerically valid, including 190925 nonland cells. Mask land!=1 explicitly; _FillValue alone does not mask oceans.
quantity: Monthly total precipitation in millimeters; liquid precipitation plus frozen precipitation water equivalent. Spatially interpolated adjusted and homogenized station series, not station measurements at each grid point.
derivation: Average each calendar month across 30 years only when all 30 monthly totals are finite, nonnegative, and unequal to -999. Sum all 12 complete monthly averages and retain only land==1. Missing data remain missing.
primaryFigure: Supplementary Figure S2.3: 1961–1990 and 1991–2020 average annual precipitation amounts (mm), based on CanGridP mlyV2.
reuse: Copy, modify, publish, translate, adapt and distribute are allowed, including commercially, subject to source attribution and a licence link where possible. Do not imply government endorsement.
attribution: Source: Environment and Climate Change Canada, CanGridP mlyV2. Annual 1991–2020 averages calculated from monthly gridded total precipitation. Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada.
distinctionFromPublishedNormals: The separately published CanGridP_Norm_mlyV2.nc covers 1961–1990, not 1991–2020. This deliverable derives modern annual normals from the published monthly series; do not call it an original ECCC 1991–2020 normals file.
readmeMismatch: ReadMe references land_mask and grid_area, but the actual NetCDF variable names are land and grid area; use the actual inspected names.
regionalAveraging: Use supplied grid area values in square kilometers as weights; an unweighted national average is not appropriate.
rendering: Source land/missing masks must be preserved. Parent should clip coarse cell footprints to its trustworthy Canada outline. Do not extrapolate into missing or nonland cells.
observedCoverageStatus: Final valid and missing land counts, northern counts, extrema and hashes are recorded in annual-precipitation-summary.json after extraction completes.
